title: Esc menu
note: The menu over the running game (no pause): Esc (ui_cancel) opens and closes it; the game runs on, the mouse is free while it is open and captured again on close. The page shows one frame per tab and case.

states.label: Лобі: хост
states.note: In the lobby, the host's view (the Esc menu opens on Lobby there): presets, the settings the host edits live, the room code with Copy, the players and Ready. Role is hidden in the lobby.

states.label: Лобі: гравець
states.note: A player's view of the same tab, and everyone's in a round (settings change only in the lobby): values without steppers, tasks as static chips, the host's name by a lock. This player joined with the code, so the code row shows.

states.label: Лобі: без коду
states.note: The host's view when the code service closed or was never reachable: one line in place of the code row.

states.label: Персонаж
states.note: In the lobby: the name and the body colour apply live.

states.label: Персонаж у раунді
states.note: In a round: locked; the name is read-only and the swatches take no input.

states.label: Гра: хост
states.note: In a round (the menu opens on Game there), the host: Leave and Quit open the confirm dialog.

states.label: Гра: гравець
states.note: In a round, a player: Leave and Quit act at once.

states.label: Гра: підтвердження
states.note: The host pressed Leave: the confirm dialog (P1) over the menu. Quit opens the same dialog titled esc.game.quit_confirm with Confirm esc.game.quit.

states.label: Роль: інженер
states.note: In a round only: the own role and its goal.

states.label: Роль: дисидент
states.note: A dissident also sees the team; the list scrolls when it is longer than the view. With no teammates the Team column is hidden.

states.label: Посібник
states.note: Every how-to card: the basics from the tutorial and one card per task type; Switches selected.

states.label: Звук і голос
states.note: Settings opens on Sound and voice. Voice activation is selected, so the threshold row shows. The main menu opens this same Settings subtree (s2).

states.label: Керування
states.note: Interact is capturing a key; Talk was rebound to M, so Talk and Map show Same key. The list scrolls.

states.label: Мова
states.note: The game language; it applies at once.

states.label: Навчання
states.note: The tutorial's menu: only Game, Guide and Settings; Leave goes back to the main menu.

nodes.name: Dim
nodes.note: Dims the running game behind the menu.

children.name: Tabs
children.note: One ButtonGroup; the selected tab shows its page. Default tab: Lobby in the lobby, Game in a round and in the tutorial; the last tab is kept for the session. Role is hidden in the lobby; the tutorial shows only Game, Guide and Settings. Focus starts on the selected tab (on Game, Resume takes it).

children.name: Title
children.note: The selected tab's name.

children.name: Lock
children.note: self_modulate = font_color of ToyTextMutedOnLight.

children.name: Presets
children.note: One ButtonGroup over the cards. A card applies its values; any other change deselects every card (a player then reads preset.custom). Save your own stores one custom preset: a card named preset.custom appears before Save.

children.name: Standard
children.note: In the game the card's text is VBox(ToyColumnFour) · @CENTER · mouse_filter IGNORE holding Name: Label(ToyPresetCardName) preset.standard and Note: Label(ToyPresetCardNoteSelected) unit.minutes {count}=10 (ToyPresetCardNote on an idle card, ToyPresetCardNoteSelected on the selected one). The page draws only the name, as the Button's text (the same font and colours), until a Button can hold Labels without a key.

children.name: Quick
children.note: As Standard: Name preset.quick, Note unit.minutes {count}=5.

children.name: NoKnives
children.note: As Standard: Name preset.no_knives, Note tr_n unit.knives, count 0.

children.name: Save
children.note: Saves the current values as the own preset.

children.name: Preset
children.note: {preset} is tr() of the applied preset's name key (preset.standard, preset.quick, preset.no_knives), or preset.custom.

children.name: SettingList
children.note: The host's edits apply live for everyone.

children.name: Field
children.note: The lobby name (#214), lobby.default_name until the host changes it; max_length per #214; auto_translate_mode DISABLED. editable false for a player (the quiet read-only box).

children.name: Less
children.note: Steps the value down (ui_left on the row does the same); disabled (unplugged) at the lower bound. Every stepper below works the same; a player sees only the value.

children.name: More
children.note: Steps the value up; disabled (unplugged) at the upper bound.

children.name: Value
children.note: In the game: Label(ToySettingRowValue) · min 80×0 · horizontal_alignment CENTER, text str(value) (sample 6), auto_translate_mode DISABLED. The page leaves the number out until the deck has a data-value key.

children.name: Less
children.note: Disabled (unplugged): 1 is the lower bound.

children.name: Value
children.note: In the game: Label(ToySettingRowValue) · min 80×0 · horizontal_alignment CENTER, text str(value) (sample 1), auto_translate_mode DISABLED. The page leaves the number out until the deck has a data-value key.

children.name: Value
children.note: In the game: Label(ToySettingRowValue) · min 80×0 · horizontal_alignment CENTER, text str(value) (sample 2), auto_translate_mode DISABLED. The page leaves the number out until the deck has a data-value key.

children.name: Allowed
children.note: One toggle per task type, not grouped: selected = allowed.

children.name: Shown
children.note: A player sees allowed tasks as ToyChipLight plates and banned ones as ToyChipLineOnLight plates with ToyChipLineOnLightText.

children.name: SwitchSteps
children.note: One row per complex task type (#256), hidden while that task is banned.

children.name: Value
children.note: In the game: Label(ToySettingRowValue) · min 80×0 · horizontal_alignment CENTER, text str(value) (sample 3), auto_translate_mode DISABLED. The page leaves the number out until the deck has a data-value key.

children.name: CodeRow
children.note: The room code, to whoever knows it: the host and each player who joined with it (never an address). After Label comes Code: PanelContainer(ToyKeyOnLight) > Label(ToyKeyText) with the room code "K7Q2XR" (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), drawn as a keycap as on the lobby HUD (s4); it is left out of this mock-up until the format can draw a text that is not a deck key.

children.name: Copy
children.note: DisplayServer.clipboard_set(code); the text reads esc.lobby.copied for 1.5 s, then esc.lobby.copy again.

children.name: CodeGone
children.note: In place of CodeRow when the code service closed or was never reachable.

children.name: Name
children.note: One row per player in join order: the own row reads player.you, the host's row lobby.host_mark with the host's name, the others the name alone (auto_translate_mode DISABLED). In the host's own view the first row is the own one.

children.name: Ready
children.note: Shown while the player is ready (self_modulate = font_color of ToySettingRowText); not ready leaves the slot empty (no dash).

children.name: Ready
children.note: toggle_mode true: toggles the own ready state; while ready the button shows the check icon before its text (the same as the row mark).

children.name: Lock
children.note: self_modulate = font_color of ToyChipLineOnLightText.

children.name: Preview
children.note: In the game: SubViewportContainer (stretch true) · min 380×506 with a SubViewport showing the own character; the page draws a ToyHowtoFrame placeholder.

children.name: Form
children.note: Changes apply live in the lobby. The Hat row (esc.character.hat) stays hidden until hats exist.

children.name: Field
children.note: The player's name, kept between sessions; auto_translate_mode DISABLED. editable false in a round.

children.name: Swatches
children.note: The ten body colours (#255; the palette is not decided yet).

children.name: Swatch1
children.note: In the game: TextureButton · toggle_mode · one ButtonGroup · 26×26 (focus_mode ALL in the lobby, NONE in a round; mouse_filter IGNORE in a round). The disc is tinted with the body colour (content data, #255): the page draws every disc in the context's ink until it can show sample colours.

children.name: Disc
children.note: self_modulate = the body colour.

children.name: Ring
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE.

children.name: Sel
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE; visible while the swatch is selected or focused.

children.name: Resume
children.note: Closes the menu (as Esc). Takes focus when the menu opens on Game.

children.name: Leave
children.note: The host: coral (ToyButtonDanger), opens the confirm dialog. A player: ToyButtonSecondary, leaves at once. In the tutorial: ToyButtonSecondary esc.game.leave_tutorial, back to the main menu (s2).

children.name: Quit
children.note: The host: opens the confirm dialog (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). A player, and in the tutorial: quits at once.

children.name: Role
children.note: Reads only the own role and Teammates.

children.name: Team
children.note: Dissidents only; hidden when there are no teammates.

children.name: Scroll
children.note: The view is 250 px tall; the list scrolls when it is longer.

children.name: Mark
children.note: self_modulate = font_color of ToyTextOnLight.

children.name: Name
children.note: The teammate's name (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: V
children.note: One ButtonGroup over every chip; a chip shows its card, titled with the chip's text.

children.name: Moving
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.move.title, .pick_up.title, .put_down.title, .hand_belt.title.

children.name: Voice
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.voice.title, tutorial.step.voice.how, tutorial.list.death.

children.name: Downed
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.downed.title, downed.give_up_hold, tutorial.step.death.title, tutorial.step.death.how.

children.name: Gap
children.note: A spacer: 8 + 8 + 8 = 24 px between the Downed chip and the Tasks caption.

children.name: Delivery
children.note: Card frames: howto.delivery.take, .sign, .find, .drop (done frame).

children.name: Card
children.note: P8 how-to card; a card is content data per task type (#254).

children.name: Art
children.note: Placeholder art until the card art (prime-game-ui#3).

children.name: Settings
children.note: The same subtree (one scene) as the main menu's Settings panel (s2): the mic, the mode, the threshold with its live meter, noise suppression and the volumes work without a session. Saved per player.

children.name: Sub
children.note: One ButtonGroup; Settings opens on Sound and voice.

children.name: Mic
children.note: Without the voice add-on, Mic, TalkMode, Threshold and MicTest give way to one Label(ToyTextMutedOnLight) settings.voice_unavailable.

children.name: Device
children.note: Items: settings.mic.default, then the device names (not translated). A pick opens the device under the existing "opening" mark.

children.name: Mode
children.note: Voice activation (with the threshold row), push to talk (the Talk key) or off. A dropdown like Mic: three chips would not fit the main menu's Settings panel at large text.

children.name: Threshold
children.note: Shown for voice activation only.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The voice-activation threshold, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Meter
children.note: The live mic level; it runs without a session (#301).

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup: RNNoise off or on.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The Master bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The voice bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The effects bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The music bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Bind
children.note: In the game: Button(ToyKeyButton) · wide (min 96), text = the bound key's label (DisplayServer.keyboard_get_label_from_physical() of the action's binding; Space and the mouse buttons through key.space, key.mouse_left, key.mouse_right). Drawn here as its idle face (ToyKeyOnLight with ToyKeyText, the same look) until a Button can show a data label. A click or ui_accept starts capture.

children.name: Bind
children.note: Capturing: the held look and settings.controls.press_key; the next key or mouse button binds, Esc cancels. Idle it shows the bound key's label (E).

children.name: Same
children.note: Only on rows whose key clashes with another action of the same phase (here Map and Talk on M); give_up and ready share F legally (different phases, #211).

children.name: ResetGap
children.note: A spacer: 4 + 12 + 4 = 20 px between the last row and Reset.

children.name: Reset
children.note: Restores the default bindings. Esc itself is fixed.

children.name: Mode
children.note: One ButtonGroup: DisplayServer window mode.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup. On swaps GameUi's theme to game_theme_large.tres live.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup; the default comes from DisplayServer.accessibility_should_reduce_animation().

children.name: Choice
children.note: One ButtonGroup; each language is named in itself (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); the language applies at once (#208). A long list later would take ToyRadio rows.

nodes.name: ConfirmDim
nodes.note: Blocks input to the menu behind while the dialog is open.

nodes.name: Confirm
nodes.note: P1. Opened by the host's Leave (esc.game.leave_confirm, Confirm esc.game.leave) or Quit (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). ui_cancel = Cancel.

children.name: ConfirmButton
children.note: Ends the session for every player and returns to the main menu (Quit: quits the game).

children.name: Cancel
children.note: Focus on open; closes the dialog.
